sql:
SELECT
  metric_time__month
  , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_5
GROUP BY
  metric_time__month
answer: 2026年7月净销售额为315.00元，8月净销售额为1003.00元。口径为按原订单下单日期归属月份，统计已支付订单实付金额减退款，取消单不计；范围为青禾当前测试数据，按月汇总。
